Commentary.Commentary: So 293 to get from 50 overs on this batting-friendly track and one would feel that Bangladesh are on top. Ireland will have to bowl really well to defend this total. Bangladesh's reply is not too far away. So don't forget to join us for the second innings.

As for Bangladesh's bowling, Abu Jayed was the star for them picking up his maiden 5-fer in ODI cricket. Rubel Hossain and Mohammad Saifuddin were the others who got into the wicket's column and the latter's brilliant final over saw Ireland fail to reach the mystic 300-run mark. Shakib Al Hasan though had a nightmare of a day with the ball. In his 9 overs he went for 65 runs and took only a wicket.

After winning the toss and opting to to bat first. Paul Stirling got them off to a good start but James McCollum had a brief stay at the crease. Andy Balbirnie was looking good out in the middle but he could not last long either. But then what followed was classic batting. The two experienced batsmen, Stirling and Porterfield, showed their class and excellence. The duo added mammoth 174-run stand for the 4th wicket with Paul Stirling going on to get a brilliant century and his skipper just missing out on a well deserved century by 6 runs. Ireland though could not make the most of the partnership. Once Porterfield got out, the others followed him. The Irish might be slightly disappointed to miss out on getting 300.
Hmmm.... 292/8! Ireland have got a good score. But do they have the bowling to stop a hard-hitting Bangladesh side?

OUT! Bowled 'em! Yorker on middle, Dockrell looks to paddle it over the fine leg fence but he misses and the ball goes on to hit the middle stump. Just 2 runs and 2 wickets from the last over. IRELAND FINISH ON 292/8.
Full on the pads, Barry looks to paddle but gets a feather on it. Rahim dives to his left and makes an excellent stop. Keeping it just to one.
Barry McCarthy is the new man in.

OUT! Hit Wicket! Lucky or funny - don't know what to call it? Saifuddin had built the pressure by bowling brilliant yorkers. Adair was way back in his crease. He again bowls a yorker outside off, Adair looks to hit it but gets way back in the crease. Ends up hitting the stumps with his bat.
Another brilliant yorker. It is outside off, Adair looks to play it but misses. Brilliant from Saifuddin.
Full on off, Dockrell comes down and hits it to long on for a run.
Excellent yorker from Saifuddin. It is on middle, Dockrell cannot do much but just dig it out.
Full on middle, Dockrell hits it to the man at mid-wicket on a bounce for a single.
On off, Dockrell hits it wide of long off and gets a couple.

OUT! That's the fifer for Jayed. He has the last laugh over Wilson. Full outside off, Wilson looks to go over the man at point but he does not time it and it goes straight to Shakib Al Hasan who takes an easy catch. Cannot blame Wilson for going after every ball here. George Dockrell is the new man in.
FOUR! Wilson is going after Jayed here. Bouncer from Jayed, Wilson pulls it over the fine leg region and gets a boundary.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, Wilson smashes it past point for a boundary.
Outside off on a length, Wilson guides it towards backward point for a couple.
Full on off, Wilson looks to play it over the off side but gets an inside edge onto his pad. They take a leg bye as the ball goes towards point.
On middle and leg, Adair hits it to long on and gets a run.
Full on middle and leg, Wilson hits it to long on for a single.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full on middle and leg, Adair hits it wide of long on for a couple.
SIX! Brilliant from Adair. He has just come out to bat but he has whacked this one over mid-wicket. Back of a length on off, Adair pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Mohammad Saifuddin is back.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The new man in is Garry Wilson.

OUT! A brilliant knock from Stirling comes to an end. Full on leg, Stirling gets on one knee and looks to go over the fielder at mid-wicket. He does not time it well and it goes high in the air but straight to Liton Das who takes a good catch. Stirling cannot convert it to his highest score but it is an innings he will fondly remember.
WIDE! Bouncer bounces too high. It goes over the head of Stirling. Wide signalled.
The new man in is Mark Adair.

OUT! Third wicket of the day for Abu. He has bowled brilliantly today. Short on middle, Kevin looks to go over long on but gets a top edge on his pull and the ball goes towards long on. Tamim comes in and takes a simple catch.
On the pads, Paul looks to flick but gets a top edge towards cover for a single.
In the air but safe. Full on off, Paul looks to go over long off but top edges it. It falls short of the long off fielder and they get a couple.
Full on the pads, Kevin looks to flick but gets hit on the pads and they take a leg bye.
On the pads, Kevin flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets a single. 23 runs off the over.
Now a single. Floated on middle and leg, Paul hits it hard to long on for a run.
FOUR! Floated on the pads, Shakib sweeps it fine down the leg side for a boundary. This is turning out to be a very expensive over.
WIDE! Quick and wide outside off, Paul leaves it alone and it is wided by the umpire.
SIX! This is the best of the lot. Make that 16 off the first three. Floated on middle and leg, Stirling whacks it over the long on fence for a mammoth six.
SIX! 10 off the first two deliveries. He is going after Shakib here. Short on middle and off, Stirling pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
FOUR! Tossed up on middle, Paul smashes it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Shakib Al Hasan is back on.
On the pads once again, Kevin gets off the mark with a flick wide of deep mid-wicket for a couple.
On the pads, Paul flicks it to the on side for a run.
Kevin O'Brien is the new man in.

OUT! Porterfield holes out. He misses out on a well deserved century. A very low full toss outside off, Porterfield looks to go over covers but does not time it. Liton Das runs to his right and takes a good catch with a slide. Das walks out to a standing ovation from his team-mates and the crowd.
FOUR LEG BYES! Full length ball outside off, Porterfield looks to play the paddle sweep but it goes off his pads towards the third man fence. 4 leg byes signalled.
Length ball on off, Paul whacks it to mid-wicket and gets another run.
Low full toss on middle and leg, WP nudges it to long on for a run.
Abu Jayed is back into the attack.
Low full toss on middle, Porterfield strokes it to long off and gets a run.
Length ball on off, Stirling strokes it past cover for a run.
On the pads, Porterfield tucks it to the on side and gets a run.
Play and a miss. Length ball outside off, Porterfield swings his bat but misses.
Around off, PS milks it to long off and rotates the strike.
Full on off, Porterfield drives it to long off for a run.
Outside off, WP drives it towards point for a run. 19 runs off the over.
SIX! Follows the boundary with a maximum. This is brilliant batting. On middle and off, William gets under it and smashes it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
FOUR! Creamed! Length ball outside off, Porterfield smashes it through covers for a boundary.
Outside off, Paul runs it down to third man for a run.
Fuller on the pads, WP looks to flick but misses. It goes off his pads towards backward square for a leg bye.
Replacement ball being taken as this one has been lost.
SIX! Up and over. Length ball outside off, Porterfield gets under the ball and whacks it over the square leg fence. He did not time it well but had enough to clear the ropes.
Shorter delivery on off, William pulls it away to deep mid-wicket and keeps the strike.
Length ball outside off, Porterfield looks to slap it but misses.
Length ball on off, Paul defends it towards point and rotates the strike.
Full on leg, WP paddle sweeps it down to fine leg for a run.

100 FOR PAUL STIRLING. His 11th in this format. He has been excellent in this inning. He got two lives and he made the most of it. He reaches to this milestone with a single down to long on. He removes his helmet and raises his bat in appreciation. He also gets down on his knees and kisses the turf thanking the almighty.
Length ball outside off, WP punches it to deep cover and gives the strike to Stirling who is on 99.
Mohammad Saifuddin is back on.
On off, Porterfield milks it to long on for a run.
Fuller on off, WP drives it straight to cover.
Length ball outside off, Paul punches it hard but the man at deep cover gets there so only a single. On 99 now.
Slower delivery on a length, Stirling manges to go through with his pull. It goes to fine leg and they rotate the strike.
Shorter on off, Stirling pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full outside off, Porterfield hits it wide of mid off for a run.
Once again Rubel offers width and cuts it wide of sweeper cover for a couple. He moves to 97.
Length ball on off, Porterfield defends it on the off side with soft hands for a run.
Short ball around off, WP pulls it wide of mid-wicket for a couple.
Outside off, this time Paul punches it to cover for a run.
FOUR! Stand and deliver. Good length ball outside off, Rubel offers width. Stirling makes the most of it and whacks it over mid off for a boundary.

Excellent shot. Length ball outside off, Paul cuts it wide of third man. Tamim gives it a chase and stops it before going to the fence. The batsmen look for three but they do not get it and they have to settle for two.
Length ball around off, Paul plays it wide of cover for a run. Bangladesh desperately need a wicket.
On middle and pitching on length, Stirling calmly defends it off his front foot.
On off, Paul taps it back to the bowler.
Hint of away swing on it. Pitched on a length around off, Stirling hits it straight to the man at cover.
Good length ball outside off, William slaps it to deep cover for a run.
Good length ball on off, Stirling plays it to deep cover for a run.
Outside off, Stirling taps it to third man and keeps the strike.
Around off, Porterfield hits it to long off and gets a run.
Play and a miss. It is on a length outside off. It goes away with the angle. Porterfield looks to play it with the line but it goes past his bat to the keeper.
Good length ball around off, Stirling easily punches it to deep cover for a run.
Nicely struck for one. Very full outside off, WP plays it to the man at deep extra cover for an easy single.
Length ball on off, Porterfield hits it straight to cover.
Rubel Hossain is back on.
In the air but safe. Length ball outside off, Stirling looks to hit it over the off side but gets a thick outside edge. It flies wide of third man and they get a run to finish off the over.
Good shot but just a single. Outside off, Stirling slaps it hard but it goes to sweeper cover and he gets just a run.
On the pads, Stirling glances it to short fine leg.
On a length attacking the stumps, Paul calmly blocks it. They are having no troubles facing Mortaza here.
Length ball outside off, Paul hits it to the man at point.
Full on off, Porterfield drives it wide of cover for a run.
Quicker on the stumps, Paul calmly blocks it.
Shorter on off, Porterfield slaps it wide of point and gets a run.
WIDE! Shakib misses his  accuracy and bowls it down the leg side. The umpire stretches his arms out to signal it as wide.
Tossed up on off, PS strokes it past cover and rotates the strike.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floated on off, William milks it to long off for a run.
FOUR! Executed to perfection. Floated on middle, Porterfield brings out the reverse sweep and connects it hard past the man at deep point for a boundary.
On off, Porterfield hits it wide of the man at mid off and gets a single. He will keep the strike.
Outside off on a length, Stirling runs it down to third man and gets another run. Bangladesh need to do something here. These two have been untroubled in this innings.
Slightly short on off, PS punches it hard but straight to point.
Length ball outside off, Paul hits it straight to the man at point.
Full on middle, Porterfield strokes it to long on and gets to the other end.
Full on off, William drives it straight to the man at cover.
Floated on the stumps, Paul blocks it off his front foot.
Flighted on off and middle, Porterfield strokes it to long on for a run.
Tossed up on off, Stirling milks it to long off for a run. With that the 100-run stand comes up between the two. Their batting has been a joy to watch.
On the stumps, Stirling blocks it off the front foot.
FIFTY FOR PORTERFIELD. This will bring a lot of joy to the fans of Ireland cricket. His 16th ODI fifty. He gets there by stroking it towards long on for a run to get to his 50.
Flighted on middle and leg, Stirling nudges it to long on for a run.
On the pads, Stirling flicks it away to the on side for a run.
Shorter on off, Porterfield easily pulls it away for another single.
Outside off, PS hits it straight to the man at mid off.
Length ball outside off, Stirling runs it down to third man and rotates the strike.
Shorter on off, William punches it towards cover and gets a single.
On the pads, Stirling flicks it to the on side and gets a run.
Floated outside off, Porterfield looks to defend but misses.
WIDE! Shakib in a rare occurrence misses his line and sprays it down the leg side. WP looks to flick but misses.
Floated on off, PS milks it to long off for a run.
Flatter on off, Paul Stirling plays it to the point.
Flighted on the stumps, Paul calmly taps it back to the bowler.
Tossed up on middle and leg, William milks it to long on and gets an easy single.
Quicker on the stumps, Porterfield blocks it off his front foot.
Around off, WP drives it square for a run. He will keep the strike.
On the pads, PS flicks it to the on side for a run.
Now follows it up with a solid front foot defense. These two are batting really smartly here.
FOUR! Mortaza makes the mistake of offering Stirling width. He makes the most of it and smokes it over the fielder at point for a boundary.
On the stumps, PS calmly defends it.
Full on off, WP strokes it to cover and gets a run.
On middle and leg, Stirling tucks it to mid-wicket.
On the stumps, blocks off the front foot by Paul.
Tossed up on the pads, WP sweeps it towards fine leg for a run.
On off, Porterfield punches it to the man at cover.
FOUR! Short outside off, Porterfield slashes it through covers for yet another boundary. He is getting a move on  now.
Floated on off, Paul comes down the track and hits it to mid-wicket.
Beauty to finish the over. Full outside off. It moves away just a hint after pitching. Porterfield looks to drive but misses.
Outside off, WP looks to hit it to the off side but gets a bottom edge and it goes behind to the keeper on a bounce.
Fuller on off, Porterfield hits it straight to the man at mid off.
Outside off, Porterfield hits it past cover and gets two as he did not time it well to reach the fence.
Outside off on a length, Porterfield cuts it but straight to point.
Morataza starts with a full delivery outside off, Paul strokes it to deep cover and gets to the other end.
Mashrafe Mortaza has introduced himself into the attack now.
FOUR! Excellent finish to the over from an Irish prospective. Short on off, William makes the full use of it and thrashes it through cover for a boundary.
William has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up outside off, Porterfield looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pad. Shakib puts in a huge appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Maybe the impact was the problem.
Shorter on the stumps, Porterfield gets on his back foot and blocks it.
Floated on off, Porterfield blocks it off his front foot.
On the pads, Paul flicks it towards short fine leg and gets a quick single. The fielder there is not quick to get on to the ball so it is an easy run in the end.
PS flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Stirling has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Driven towards the mid on region by Paul.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Porterfield rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Porterfield nudges it to long on for a single.
Flighted on off, Paul milks it to the man at long off.
Outside off, PS hits it to the man at point.
Follows it up with a single down to long on. Smart batting this.
FOUR! Tossed up on middle and leg, Porterfield picks it up early and sweeps it brilliantly through backward square leg for a boundary.
William has played it towards mid-wicket.
Floated on middle, Porterfield strokes it to long on for a run.
On the pads again this time, PS glances it past the fielder for one.
On the pads, flicked straight to the man at 45.
Short on off, Porterfield cuts it through point for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Paul flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Tossed up on the stumps, William calmly blocks it.
Floated on off, PS nudges it to long off for a run.
Now follows it up with a single down to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Short, wide and punished. It is outside off, asking to be punished. Porterfield says thank you very much and slaps it through covers for a boundary.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On the pads, PS flicks it straight to the man at 45.
In the air but safe. Flatter outside off, Porterfield looks to slap it over covers but gets a thick outside edge but it falls short of the man at short third man.
WP rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
On the pads once gain, PS tucks it to the on side and rotates the strike.
Flatter on off, Porterfield milks it towards cover and gets to the other end.
On the pads, Porterfield flicks it straight to the man at short fine leg.
Floated on off, WP blocks it off his front foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On the pads, William flicks it to mid-wicket and gets a single.
Outside off, Porterfield looks to play the reverse sweep but gets hit on the pads.
Straighter one outside off, WP looks to defend but gets beaten.
Floated on off, Paul strokes it to long off for a run.

DROPPED AGAIN! Stirling gets two lives in two balls. This should have been taken especially at this level. Shakib should have had a wicket off his very first ball. Short and wide outside off, Paul cuts it uppishly towards point. Saifuddin there gets it at a comfortable height and it is straight at him but he cannot hold onto it.

Dropped! Sabbir Rahman is the culprit here. Floated on off, Stirling looks to break the shackle and go over long off. He does not time it and it falls in front of Sabbir. He gets down but the ball pops out of his hand.
Shakib Al Hasan is into the attack.
Make that 4 singles on the trot. Shorter on leg, WP pulls it away to square leg for a run.
Third single of the over. On the pads, Stirling flicks it away for a run.
On the pads, Porterfield works it down the leg side and rotates the strike.
Short again on middle, Stirling nudges it to long on and gets a run.
Shorter on middle, Stirling knocks it to the right of the bowler.
Dot to finish the over. On off and middle, Porterfield defends. Just 7 runs have come off the last 3 overs.
Outside off on a length, WP hits it to the man at cover.
Length ball on off and middle, WP defends it off his front foot.
Full on off, Paul hits it towards long off and gets to the the end.
On the stumps, Paul blocks it off his front foot.
On middle, WP plays it wide of cover for a single.
Tossed up on middle, WP nudges it to long on and keeps the strike.
Floated on off, Paul strokes it towards long off for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floated on off and middle, PS hits it to the man at mid on. Three dots to begin the over.
Tossed up on off and middle, Stirling taps it back to the bowler.
On the pads, PS flicks it straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Length ball on off, Stirling ends the over with a single. He punches the ball towards cover.
On the pads, Stirling looks to flick it but gets a leading edge which falls way before the short third man fielder.
On the body, Porterfield works it down to fine leg for a run.
Full on middle, Paul milks it to long on and gets to the other end.
Length ball on off, Stirling hits it straight to mid off.
On the stumps, Sterling defends it off his front foot.
Floated on off, PS drives it to long off and keeps the strike.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On the pads, WP flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.
FIFTY FOR STIRLING. His 20th in ODI cricket. He has looked in brilliant touch today. He gets to his half ton with a glance down to fine leg for a run.
On middle and off, WP whips it towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
On the pads, PS flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, Paul plays it wide of point and gets a run.
Full on off, Stirling defends it off his front foot.
Good running there. Back of  a length ball on off, Porterfield defends it with soft hands towards point and calls for a quick single. His partner responds swiftly and they get the run with ease.
Solid front foot defends on display there. Full on off, WP shows his confidence with a brilliant front foot defense.
On off and middle, PS flicks it away towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Good length ball on off, Paul tucks it to mid on.
Dot to finish the over. Just that boundary from the over. Hossain loops it on off, WP defends it classically.
Quicker on the pads, Porterfield once again looks to sweep but misses and it hits his pad on its way to the keeper.
FOUR! Swept and swept fine. Floated on the pads, Porterfield sweeps it past the short fine leg fielder towards the backward square leg fence for a boundary.
Short on off, WP punches it to the man at cover.
Flighted on off, Porterfield blocks it off his front foot.
Shorter on middle and leg, William punches it to the man at mid on.
Defended off the back foot by Paul.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground
On the pads, Paul flicks it away wide of deep square leg once again and gets a couple.

Outside edge to the rescue. Good length ball on middle and leg, Paul looks to defend but the ball move away sharply. He gets an outside edge onto his thigh pad. Saifuddin goes up in appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Bowls it on middle and leg, Stirling flicks it wide of deep square leg for a couple.
On the pads, William flicks it to the on side for a run.
On the pads, Paul flicks it to the mid-wicket fielder.
FOUR! Beautifully driven. Hossain tosses it up outside off, Paul continues his impressive form and drives it exquisitely through covers for a boundary.
Tossed up on the pads, William this time flicks it away from the mid-wicket fielder and gets a run.
Shorter on middle, Porterfield tucks it to the on side.
On middle and leg, William flicks it but to the man at mid-wicket.
Floated on the pads, Paul flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
Mosaddek Hossain is introduced into the attack.
Good length ball outside off, Paul taps it past point for a run. Keeps the strike.
Now calmly blocks it off his front foot.
FOUR! A very poor delivery from Saifuddin. He bowls it on the pads, Stirling glances it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
On the pads, Porterfield flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
Length ball outside off, William lets it carry to the keeper.
Starts with a length ball on off, Porterfield blocks it.
Mohammad Saifuddin is the first bowling change.
On the pads, Porterfield flicks it to the on side and gets off the mark. He will also keep the strike.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

OUT! Jayed gets rid of the man in form. Balbirnie who was looking so good has to depart. Back of a length ball going down the leg side. Andy goes to pull it but gets a faint feather on it and Mushfiqur Rahim moves to his left and takes a good catch. A soft dismissal to say the least. Andy walks back gutted. Bangladesh willl take it though. William Porterfield walks out to replace Andy Balbirnie.
On off, Balbirnie blocks it off his front foot.
On the pads, Balbirnie flicks it wide of deep square leg and gets a couple.
FOUR! Andy is continuing his impressive form. Length ball outside off, Balbirnie drives it past the point fielder for a boundary.
Powerplay 2 signalled by the umpire. Now 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
On off, Paul blocks it off his front foot to finish the over.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery
Once again length ball has been punched but straight to the man at cover.
On off, Paul blocks it off his back foot.
Length ball outside off, Stirling punches it to the man at cover.
Straight drive but it is too straight. Full on middle and off, Paul drives it straight to the stumps at the non-striker's end.
EDGE AND FOUR. Another good ball. Full on off and once again shaping away. Balbirnie looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge which flies through the vacant slip cordon for a boundary.
Good ball. Length ball pitching on off and shaping away from the batsman. Balbirnie looks to drive but he misses and the ball goes just past the outside edge to the keeper.
On middle, Balbirnie drives it straight to mid on.
Fuller on off, Balbirnie drives it to the right of the bowler. Jayed cannot stop it cleanly. The ball deflects off his hand to mid on but it costs no run.
Corrects his line and length and bowls it on the stumps, Balbirnie blocks it.
WIDE! Length ball outside off, it is too wide and on the wrong side of the tramline. Andy leaves it alone and the umpire signalls it as wide.
FOUR! Beautiful! Balbirnie's rich vein of form continues. Length ball outside off, Andy smashes it past point for a boundary.
Yes it is. Excellent from Hossain. Good length ball on middle, Stirling defends it to the man at mid on to see off the over.
Length ball on middle, Paul defends it towards mid on. 5 dots off the over so far. First maiden of the day?
Outside off, Paul taps it to the man at point.
Length ball outside off, Paul cuts it hard but close to the man at cover. He dives to his right and stops the ball.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
Paul has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Outside off, Andy punches it to the man at cover to see off the over.
Good length ball on middle and leg. The ball comes in with the angle, Andy looks to flick it but gets hit high on the pads. Jayed puts in the appeal though but the umpire is not interested.

FOUR! Poor ball but an excellent placement from the batsman. It is on the pads, Andy after defending the first three was waiting for a bad ball. He gets it and flicks it through square leg. The man at fine leg gives it a chase but has no chance and the ball races away to the fence.
Full outside off, Balbirnie drives it straight to mid off.
Length ball on off, Andy taps it back to the bowler.
On off, Andy drives it straight. Jayed stretches out his right arm and makes a good stop off his own bowling.
Full on off, Paul drives it towards cover. He drives it hard and the fielder there misfields allowing them to get a couple. 9 off this one.

SIX! If you give Stirling poor delivery then he will make full use of it. Rubel changes his length and bowls it short. There is no one at deep mid-wicket so it is a no-risk shot. Paul pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Full on leg, Paul looks to flick but misses. He gets hit on the pads. Rubel is excited and goes up in appeal but the umpire turns him down. Probably going down leg.
Length ball outside off, Paul slaps it hard but straight to the man at cover.
On middle and leg, Andy tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a quick run.
Full on off, Andy defends it off his front foot.
Once again on the pads, Andy gets off the mark by glancing it towards mid-wicket to end the over. He will keep the strike.
On the pads, Paul flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
Length ball outside off. Tempting Stirling to drive, Paul though does not fall for the trick and calmly shoulders arms to it.
On off, Paul defends it towards the man at mid off.
FOUR! What a shot! Full outside off, Stirling gets on his front foot and drives it wonderfully past covers for a boundary. He looks in the mood today.
Poor effort from the fielder. Full outside off, Paul drives it to covers. The fielder inside the circle misfields and it goes past him allowing the batsmen to take two.
Bowls it full on off, Andy calmly defends it to see off the over. End of an eventful over. 7 runs and a wicket off this one.
Andy Balbirnie walks out at number 3.

OUT! Rubel strikes. Ireland lose their first wicket. Length ball coming in with the angle and then moves away after hitting the deck. McCollum looks to punch it but gets a thick outside edge which goes to first slip. Liton Das there takes a regulation slip catch. Though Rubel has been expensive he has given his team the breakthrough they wanted.

Now follows it up with a single. Smart batting this. Full on middle and off, Paul strokes it wide of mid on. The fielder there dives to his left and saves the ball from going past him. They take an easy single.
New ball taken as this ball has been lost after the first six.
SIX! First six of the game and it comes from the bat of Paul Stirling. Rubel pulls his length back on this occasion, Paul gets on his back foot and pulls it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Full on middle and off, Paul drives it straight to the man at mid on.
On the pads, Paul flicks it straight to mid-wicket.

Fuller delivery outside off. Once again it is moving away from the batsman. James looks to drive but misses. The ball just misses the outside edge. Excellent over from Jayed. He was not far away from getting the first wicket.
Outside off, McCollum punches it straight to cover.
WIDE! Abu misses his line and sprays it down the leg side. James looks to flick but misses. The umpire signals it as wide.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Huge appeal for lbw but turned down by the umpire. Good length ball pitching on middle and off, McCollum looks to defend it but the ball moves away after pitching. James misses the ball and it hits him on the thigh pad of his back foot. Abu asks the question but the umpire is unmoved.
Length ball outside off, James looks to play it but misses.
Length ball on off, the ball rises onto James and he defends it from the upper bat of his bat.
On the pads, Paul flicks it towards square leg and gets a couple to end the over. Expensive start for Rubel. 9 off his first.
Once again punches off the back foot but this time straight to cover.
Outside off on a length, Paul gets on his back foot and punches it through covers. He does not time it well so it does not get to the fence but they get a couple.
Nice shot and a misfield. Length ball outside off, James cuts it hard to point. The fielder there misfields which allows them to get a single.
FOUR! McCollum is off the mark. Poor ball from Rubel, he bowls it on the pads. James just helps it on its way towards the fine leg fence where no one is placed on the boundary.
Rubel starts with a full length ball on off, McCollum gets behind it and blocks it off his front foot.
Rubel Hossain to take the second new ball and bowl from the other end.
On the pads, Stirling calmly blocks it. 6 runs off the first over. Positive start for Ireland.
On the pads, Paul flicks towards square leg. The man from fine leg comes and gathers the ball but by then they take an easy couple.
FOUR! Stirling and Ireland are off the mark in style. Length ball outside off, this time Paul is able to get on his back foot and punches it through covers for a boundary.
This one keeps a bit low. Pitching on a length outside off, once again there is a hint of away movement for him. Paul looks to cut it but misses.
Now Jayed bowls it full on off, Stirling gets right behind the ball and defends it to mid on.
Jayed starts with a good outswinging delivery pitching around off, Stirling does not go for the drive and calmly leaves it on its way to the keeper.

Done and dusted with the national anthems and we are all set to begin. The Bangladesh players are out on the field and take their position on the field. Out walk the opening pair of James McCollum and Paul Stirling for Ireland. Abu Jayed to take the first new ball for Bangladesh.
The players are out in the middle for their respective national anthems.

Bangladesh skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza says they would have batted first as well had they won the toss. Tells that they need to keep the momentum going as it is very important and carry it on to the finals. Informs there are a few changes for this game but he cannot remember.

Ireland skipper, William Porterfield says that the pitch looks good and hopes that they can add more runs as the batting has been good and hence they are batting first. Tells that it is a crazy month as they have a lot of cricket to play in the Irish summer.
TOSS - Ireland win the toss and opt to bat first.

Hello and welcome to the final round-robin phase game of this Tri-nation series. Bangladesh are undefeated in this series and would look to continue their dominance heading into the final. Ireland, on the other hand, are yet to win a game and would want to end their series with a win. Can the Irish team spring a surprise or will the Asian team do what is expected of them to do? Stay tuned for updates as the toss is not far away.
